title: Zero-block acceptance value
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $T,c$ be natural numbers and $v$ a Boolean. With zero blocks, the acceptance value at offset $c$ is $1$ if the decision function sends $c$ to $v$, and is $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic machine $N$ over Boolean symbols
